title: Rule
blurb: A named production. The first rule is the start symbol unless Run is told otherwise.

title: Leaf /term/
blurb: Match term (the same language) and emit one string. Not a second regex engine. Wrap still applies inside unless a wrap-off scope says otherwise.

title: Modifier #lex
blurb: Strictness lock: this rule must stay regular. The sandbox still matches it; the compiler (T5) rejects drift.

title: Pragma #wrap
blurb: Whitespace inserted between terminals. Default in xbnf.xbnf is (\s | COMMENT)*.

title: Scoped wrap-off
blurb: Empty wrap concatenates characters with no injected space. How terminals are written.

title: Pragma #import
blurb: Include another grammar. Parsed into IR; the first-slice runner does not load the file.

title: Pragma #macro
blurb: Macro definition. Expansion is not first slice.

title: Precedence stack
blurb: > is looser-to-tighter. @ is this stack (the next tighter level).

title: Unordered alternation
blurb: Source order has no meaning. The sandbox runner takes the longest successful alternative.

title: Ordered choice
blurb: Committed choice. The first alternative that matches at this position wins. Cannot mix with | ; parenthesize to nest.

title: Sequence
blurb: Juxtaposition. Wrap is skipped between terminals.

title: Named capture
blurb: Tags the match. Also used as @:op="+" to name a stack operator.

title: Optional
blurb: Zero or one.

title: Zero or more
blurb: Zero or more greedy repetitions.

title: One or more
blurb: One or more greedy repetitions.

title: Exact count
blurb: Exactly n repetitions.

title: Count range
blurb: Inclusive min and max. Open ends: {1,} and {,3}.

title: Delimited repetition
blurb: x ("," x)*. Leading/trailing commas in the grammar syntax allow a separator before the first / after the last item.

title: Optional delimited list
blurb: JSON-style: zero or more items, no trailing comma in the input.

title: Directive
blurb: Trails a sequence. Vocabulary: #prefer / #avoid, #assoc, #priority, #longest. The runner parses them and still matches.

title: Rule reference
blurb: Invokes another rule.

title: Label filter
blurb: Run tok; succeed only if a longest-match alternative carries this label.

title: String literal
blurb: Exact text. Backtick doubles ` to escape.

title: Character class
blurb: One character. - is a range. ^ after [ negates. A token of many of these is /[A-Za-z]+/, not [A-Za-z]+.

title: Escape
blurb: Backslash class. \d digits, \s space, \n newline.

title: Leaf /term/
blurb: Match term and emit as one string. /[A-Za-z]+/ is xbnf (class plus quant), not a regex dialect.

title: Any character
blurb: One character. . is not a pragma sigil.

title: Back-reference
blurb: Match a previously captured string from a named sibling in the same production.

title: External reference
blurb: Host-provided matcher. Not executed in the first-slice runner.

title: Macro call
blurb: Expansion is not first slice.

title: Positive lookahead
blurb: Zero-width: term must match, input is not consumed.

title: Negative lookahead
blurb: Zero-width: term must fail.

title: Stack self-ref
blurb: The next tighter stack level. Used as infix @:op="+" or prefix/postfix.

title: Positional @col
blurb: Line-indent predicate. @col(=0) / @col(>0) compare the indent of the current line, not wrap-skipped cursor column.

title: Grouping
blurb: Parentheses only. Not an IR node.

title: Empty
blurb: Matches nothing.
